nom: COSRX Advanced Snail Peptide Eye Cream

avis.texte: I have dry, sensitive skin. My skin is very reactive, especially around my eyes, and I've noticed slight irritation using this. Not sure which ingredients are the culprit. It's nice and lightweight and you get a lot of product for the price compared to other eye creams, but unfortunately I can only use it infrequently without causing irritation.

I rarely feel strongly about eye creams but this is one I'll never buy again. I have oily skin and for the first time ever, an eye cream made me break out around my eyes! Extra points off for the packaging - eye creams don't need pumps, and there's no way to unscrew the top.

I was dealing with a red, burning eyelid from trying other eye products (sunday riley auto correct, clinique all about eyes rich, belif aqua eye bomb) they all stung and made my problem worse! This product healed my eye issue after just a few days. It goes on pretty slippery but dries within a few minutes, maybe less. My eyes look refreshed throughout the say and concealer doesnt seem to crease much with this serum. Wish i tried it sooner! A little goes a long way so i think it'll last awhile.

This is truly a holy grail neutral eye cream when you aren't looking for actives, an easy daily wear for me. Only thing I struggle with and prompted my review is the pump! It gets stuck very easily and more often than not despenses more than needed. I always manage with however much it gives me but would love to use the product as reccomended and have it even longer with a traditional eye cream packaging!

avis.titre: beautiful wonderful fantastic and silicone free
avis.texte: i was looking for a basic, lightweight, hydrating, silicone free eye cream. i'm 30, i dont really deal with discoloration or bags. i just wanted something comfortable for every day/night that actyally felt HYDRATING. i'm now on my third bottle of this and it lasts FOREVER. no irritation, no funny business, no disappearing after i apply it. it goes on easy while leaving a nice moisturizing sheen and still goes under makeup just fine. i'm convinced theres no other girl like her. i need to go buy another bottle right now lol
This is a delicate and smooth eye cream. It has helped to brighten and decrease puffiness for me. A little goes a long way. This will be a repurchase.
super lightweight eye serum and i have sensitive skin and have not notice any irritation at all

avis.titre: Not my favorite of all time, but pretty close.
avis.texte: I have very sensitive skin due to psoriasis, and finding an eye cream that works without irritation is challenging. This cream does a very good job at moisturizing my eye area and softening the fine lines. It does a pretty decent job with puffiness, as well. I wish that it was a bit more brightening, but for what it is and the price, it's definitely hard to beat.

55 yr old menopausal women. I've had this for months, but only recently opened it. I wish I had sooner! Great texture, light weight and fast acting. I'm super impressed. I should have known it'd be great because all of their products are- and I'm a tough sell!

I did not notice how much my eyes had brightened up until I stopped using this product. I honestly have never thought my eyes were dark until this product lightened up my eyelids and under eye area. It's also hydrating.
I love this product. I've been using for a week and already see some brightening coming through. Will definitely do another update in 3 weeks

I have no idea who would look at snail mucin and think "hey, I should put this on my face," but I am certainly glad someone did. I use the COSRX Snail Mucin Cleanser, Power Essence Serum, Eye Cream, and All In One Cream, combined with a Mario Badescu toner and a multitude of The Ordinary treatments to form a personalized and highly effective skin care regimen that has made my skin look and feel tighter, firmer, healthier, and younger. On days when I'm in a rush, the Snail Mucin line is my go-to and is effective on its own, but combined with a few Ordinary products, it's the most amazing skin care regimen I have ever used. I have had bags and wrinkles around my eyes since I was a teenager and this is the first product since the Arbonne RE9 eye cream (ridiculously expensive and hard to find) which has given me any noticeable results. Frankly, this is better than Arbonne. I look years younger.

I actually use this all over my face and I love it. This in combination with Geek and Gorgeous A Game 20 has my face smooth and glowing. Please don't ever stop selling this product. For reference I am 55 years old and people often think I am much younger.

I liked this eye cream beacauss of how lightweight it was, however it wasnt the most moisturising eye cream I've used. As someone with dry skin and very dry under eyes I was underwhelmed by the lack of hydration the product gave my under eyes. That being said though if you are looking for just a lightweight eye cream then this is fantastic!

I liked this eye cream beacauss of how lightweight it was, however it wasnt the most moisturising eye cream I've used. As someone with dry skin and very dry under eyes I was underwhelmed by the lack of hydration the product gave my under eyes. That being said though if you are looking for just a lightweight eye cream then this is fantastic!

This eye cream is very thin and I wasn't impressed with the absorption. I did not notice any significant moisturizing, brightening, etc effects to keep me a customer. But my main reason for writing this review is the packaging. Depressing the pump gently provides a tiny amount… Way less than you would use. Needing to do that several times per eye. If you press it a little harder, it goes crazy and gives you more than you would need for your whole face. What a mess!

I waited to write a review until I fully incorporated into my routine. well it's been a year and 5 jars. I can see a difference in elasticity, I wouldn't say I've seen a difference in fine lines but the skin around my eyes is smooth. also, I personally didnt have the irritation that some other reviews mention. My skin seems to really like this one. Definitely worth a try. also, the airless pump will get the last drop out.

avis.titre: Is the second time I buy this product
avis.texte: I always try to use Cruelty Free products for myself and that was the first thing that call my attention, it lasted a year or so, and I like the way it works on my skin around my eyes, and last but not least: affordable price. I recommend this!

I bought this during the sale for half off. I just have to use very tiny amount under my eyes. I'm not sure of the result of it makes a difference. But I've been using it in the morning and evening for two weeks now.
I struggle with dark circles and this did nothing for that. For the price, it does what every other eye cream can do. It moisturizes just fine, but no wow factor.
It made one of my eye swollen this never happened to me until i used this product. I only used it for four days and it became swollen. Do not recommend to anyone.
This eye cream is super hydrating and I love it. But the pump started leaking every time it was used and I honestly will not buy again just based on that. Super bummed.
Made the area around my eyes red and swollen. Now that I've taken it out of my skincare routine my eyes are slowly healing

So im in my early 40"s and was starting to notice aging in my crows feet area and always had problems with eye creams making my eyes irritated. This stuff caused no irritation all day and has smoothed the area around my eye and no more fine lines i am really impressed. Also the texture is really good

This eye cream doesn't do anything for me - it's not hydrating, doesn't address puffiness or anything else. Makeup doesn't wear well over the cream; concealer looks dry after a few hours. Won't repurchase and do not recommend.
Super lightweight, a lil goes a long way. Literally my favorite eye cream, lasted me about 3 months. Definitely worth it!
I've tried so many under eye treatments that ive been disappointed in, this one actually works!

I didn't really think this was doing anything for me after using it for like a year… I tried other more expensive eye creams they were not good at all. I tried no eye cream which was even worse my eyes were the puffiest they'd ever been in years! I was so upset I started using this product again and my eyes are back to the normal, glowing, bright, not puffy under eyes I previously had. Now I'm a true believer lol!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again!!!👍🏻
avis.texte: The hydration and luminosity of this product is amazing! I highly recommend anyone to add this product to your daily routine. Purchase at Ulta Beauty and get all the points to use for future purchases. Also, recommend to a friend and compare your results!

ive used this eye cream for several months and finally realized it has done nothing for my undereyes except hydrate them. my issues with my undereyes are dark circles snd minor wrinkles and occasional dryness. this maybe has worked for others but if your looking for long term results, maybe try another brand.

I bought this product around 2 months ago and have been using this consistently. I watched lots of tiktok videos before buying this and I heard really good stuffs about it. For the first 2 weeks it was good on my skin. I felt like it did some thing but overtime my skin around eye area kept on getting worst. I realized after using this eye cream I had little sebum around my eye area. Every time I used this product my skin looked horrible. Never purchuasing this again.
I had to scoop the product out. It is soo good though I totally recommend I'm going to rebuy because no tube :)

I'm 26 and have noticed my under eyes beginning to look a little dull and dehydrated. This has seriously been the biggest help and made the most difference of any product I've used so far. My under eye has looked moisturized, plump, and healthier overall. I will 100% be buying this again, in my opinion it is great value for money. I've seen some people say they developed milia but I have not noticed any developing on myself
I've been pleased with how this product moisturizes and my makeup goes on really great over it

avis.titre: Lightweight but got small bumps ￼under my eye
avis.texte: I was recommend this by a Ultra employee. It was super lightweight which I like but after using it for one day, I notice small little white bumps under my eyes. Wasn't a fan at all. For the price you paid it isnt bad but wouldn't recommend it.

I liked how there was no scent and how light it felt after putting it on. I don't think this made a huge difference with reducing the appearance of lines or brightening. But I do recognize there are other factors to keep in mind, like getting enough sleep. One of that benefits listed is that it "hydrates the under eye area with lightweight moisture" and I definitely feel like it did that. This product lasted about 6 months for me, using it only at night. I think it's worth giving a try at least once to see if you like it.

This eye serum gave me milia!! :(( i never had milia (small white hard bumps that cannot he popped) until i used this!! I had switched to using only this cream under my eyes - nothing else in my routine changed. Within a few weeks of usage i got 3 milia bumps!! I Never had them before in ny life!! Used cosrx mucin on my face fine in the past so i got their eye cream and had the worst experience. I Had to use glycolic acid and extraction to get rid of them. Caution!! Product is too heavy for under the eyes think skin and causes milia!! Once i stopped using this a month ago i havent had any more milia. I'm 21 years old for reference and combo skin little bit of acne.

Ive dablled in eye creams iver the years and never really found one that did much. I picked this up because my eye area was extremely dry and flaking and this has solved everything. I use this every single night and I dont have any dryness issues anymore.

avis.titre: got tiny irritated bumps all under my eye
avis.texte: went to use product and overnight my skin became irritated and i got multiple tiny buring bumps under my eyes
I absolutely love this eye cream. It's hydrating and lightweight. Cosrx's entire snail line is my holy grail.

avis.titre: I will definitely be buying this again!
avis.texte: I have fine lines around my eyes and mouth. I am 36 and had been a smoker since I was 22. This product have almost erased those lines and wrinkles and I actually look my age. I was always mistaken for being much older.

I struggled my whole life with dark circles. It wasnt until a year ago that I just accepted that I would have them forever. I received this product in the trial size so its very small (5 mL), but I use literally a dot amount on each eye before moisturizer. A little goes a long way. It's been almost 2 months of using this product and I just noticed how awake my eyes have been looking recently. I am a college student so sleep is very minimal ahah so this product is definitely pushing through. I recommend 1000%

Ive had this for like 5 months now. Used it on and off but I never got any results. You knkw how people say eye cream is just repackaged and more expensive face cream? This is one of those situations. Great to add hydration under the eyes not so much for anything else. Probably better to get an eye cream with retinol in it. I'll personally be trying out the beauty of joseon retinol eye cream next.

i really loved this product as it completely transformed my eyes and make me look more awake and youthful. but it made my skin EXTREMELY sensitive. I'd have to stop using it for days if i wanted to wax my eyebrows unless i wanted to burn my skin off. if i rubbed them too hard my skin would rip. had these things not happened, i would continue to use.
I mix it with my other moisturizer and it reminds me of the drunk elephant hydration drops because of smoothness and hydration.

I've had this for about three months and I'm not seeing a difference. Everyone skin is different, so try it out but it has not worked for me. It does feel nice on the skin but my dark circles are still very apparent.

It's okay didn't irratate my skin or anything but I saw how they extract the snail "gel" and didn't feel right buying there products afterwards it's not necessary there's way better products out there that doesn't harm or disrupt friendly snails lets leave them alone

avis.titre: I had really high hopes because I love this brand but..
avis.texte: I've been using this eye cream daily (and sometimes twice a day) for the past 2 months. I havent noticed much of a difference. My undereye is smoother but still very puffy and discolored.

I have super dry under eyes & issues with concealer being super patchy/pilly/just not cute looking. I started using this in the mornings (and at night rotating w a retinol eye cream) and waiting like 5 minutes so it dries down and it looks so good under make up and really hydrated the undereyes! I have sensitive skin and this is now a ride or die for me. (also anything cosrx from the 96 to the pimple patches and pimple cream is 10/10 for sensitive/dry skin, i dont write reviews but i love it so much i had to)
I work nights at the hospital and it works amazing for under my eyes will always recommend this product
I've tried many under eye creams , but this is really smooth and I've seen improvement in my puffiness, I need something like this for all over my face💕💕💕

Bought this because it had some decent reviews and was half the price of the eye cream I had been using. It's been about a month of using it and my goodness I love it!! Obviously can't tell you long-term impact, but this gives my undereye a plump within minutes and is non-greasy/sticky. Will be repurchasing! I'm 25 with acne prone, combination, fair/light skin for reference.

I bought this having high hopes, well, my makeup looked great for the night but the next morning I have a rash under my eyes and on my eyelids exactly where I place the product. It faded away in a few days but my face was very sensitive and irritated during that period of time. I do not recommend if you have very sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Great moisturing eye cream, good under makeup
avis.texte: I've been using this product for over a year now. I think it moisturizes really well. I usually put it on, get dressed, then come back to do makeup so it has a chance to absorb. I'm not sure how well it does with puffiness and wrinkles but mine seems to be kept at bay. It's not rocking my world for fine lines but it's great for under makeup. I have very little creasing issues which is not true with other creams I've tried.

i needed an eye cream for the evening bc my nightcreams/moisturizers were irritating the skin around my eyes. had to return a hyaluronic eye cream bc it was breaking me out. a girl on the sales recommended this me. 3 nights, no adverse reactions so i'm happy. haven't tried it under makeup so i cant say how it settles but i'm very happy w the moisturizing properties for the evenings and days i don't wear makeup. good price point and quantity.

My skin definitely became more dewy, less red, and overall a bit brighter. Where I live is very dry and this did help with hydration and moisture retention, too! This product did, as far as I can tell, nothing for brightness. I applied it all over my face (1-2 pumps) 1-2 times per day and it lasted just under 3 months.

avis.titre: Mid-20's gal with oily skin really likes it!
avis.texte: This has really worked well for me. I have oily skin and I generally stay away from cream based products, but this eye cream is very light and not heavy at all. A little goes a long way when using it. It's a very easy product to use with the pump.
I got an immediate allergic reaction to this eye cream. My eyes felt so uncomfortable as soon as I put it on within 15 minutes I had to wash it off.

Without dropping brand names, I've used others in a similar price point that did help with wrinkles. This one did not, and it was glaringly obvious after applying concealer. It did provide light moisture and was non irritating.

avis.titre: Best eye cream for dark circles!
avis.texte: I absolutely love this product. I've been looking for a good product for dark circles for years and so far this is the best I found. My roommate noticed a difference within a couple of days￼!

avis.titre: It's a texture to get used to it
avis.texte: The slimy consistency was strange as compared to the lotions I've used in the past by other brands. It is very hydrating and feels nice on the skin. I will keep using it.

this product has change my life because I've never find any good eye cream but this one is a game changer. it's very lightweight and most of your wrinkle disappear within time and just help rejuvenate moisture into my skin. I would definitely buy this again❤️❤️

I've been waiting to try this product, but it is always sold out. It was well worth the wait. I've been using it for 2 weeks, and have already noticed fantastic results. A little goes a long way and it absorbs very nicely into my skin.

avis.titre: Favorite eye cream on the market
avis.texte: I have tried a lot of basic eye creams and this one takes the cake for me I like that it has the snail mucin which makes ur eyes look plump and dewy. It also has niacinamide and peptides so it does really well for brightening the under eye area too. The best way I can describe the results it leaves is like the glass skin look but for your eyes. 100% would recommend, this is also coming from someone who has worked with beauty products for a long time, haven't found anything like it :)

I got this to try since it's so popular and I've been so curious! Within 48 hours of first use my upper lip and chin/jaw were covered in tons of tiny bumps. A little itchy, a bit red, I almost wonder if I'm allergic to something in the product? I'm gonna call it quits with this one just to be safe. I can only hope the bumps are as quick to disappear as they were to show up.
I really liked this product, and it didn't irritate my skin, and is clean!

So this product worked almost instantly to get rid of my dark circles. I was so excited because it's been an issue for me my whole life. However, after one use, the next morning i woke up with some swelling under my eyes :( not for sensitive skin
This is the perfect under eye cream! A small drop packs in SO much hydration. The skin there is always super smooth, and I always wish I had this is a larger container to use all over my face.
Takes some time to see some results, as with anything. You have to be patient while tapping it in as it absorbs slowly. Refreshing feeling, not the most brightening but does perk up the eye area.

avis.titre: My favorite under eye cream as a 23 year old
avis.texte: I use this eye cream morning and night and have noticed a huge difference. It doesn't necessarily brighten my under eyes, it mostly hydrate (which is what I needed because my under eyes were looking dry and bland). It doesn't give me milia either.
Love the look after evenly spreading around my eye and crows feet towards the corner of my eye.
This eye cream is a little underwhelming. It's pretty runny and doesn't really provide a lot of moisture as I expected. It's ok but not really thrilled with it.

Super moisturizing eye cream. It dries down to a comfortable finish — not sticky or tight. The ingredients are great, mainly for hydration and anti-aging. I don't think this is meant to get rid of dark circles, so if that's what you're looking for, you'll probably be disappointed. A little bit of product goes a VERY long way and the bottle already contains more product than most eye creams, so this product will last you a very long time, making the price reasonable.

I am 21, but from a few years of smoking I have noticed fine lines forming under my eyes. This eye cream is fantastic, the texture dries almost silky, but not sticky. I haven't been using this for long but can already see slight improvements. I highly recommend to any makeup wearers. And please, remember your sunscreen!

I've just started using and so far I am very happy with the results. I like the consistency as it's easy to put on, and a little goes a long way! I suffer from puffiness and dark circles and I have already noticed a difference after using this product for a short period of time.

avis.titre: A little goes a long way
avis.texte: This tube will last forever because you really only need the tiniest amount. I use it at night and my eyes don't feel puffy and dry in the morning
Super easy to apply, no leftover feelings of the product. My under eyes were very drying and this product definitely helped

I used this along with other products, but I'm certain this is the main component that actually made the difference for me. I used to get this deep set wrinkle between my eyebrows, it would last for a really long time after waking up but when I started using this at night, I don't even see the wrinkle anymore and when I do it's not as deep and doesn't last/ stay imprinted AT ALL. Will keep buying this for sure 🙂 For reference my routine is like so: Boscia water sake treatment Wldkat kombucha toner Boscia sake hydrating gel Sometimes hyaluronic acid (if I don't use the first Boscia step which is rare) Then this moisturizer all over my face & sometimes I layer another moisturizer on top

A lightweight moisturizer that feels light and substantial at the same time. Fine lines are less noticeable. I use a gentle patting to help it absorb. It dries within a minute making way for primer and makeup. I recommend this product.
I use it 2X a day and simply love it. Extremely soothing, not heavy at all. Does the trick in de-puffing eyes.

No fragrance, easy to use pump, and gives a ton of hydration without any greasy residue or heavy feeling. Makeup also applies wonderful over it! I'm still in my 20s but have definitely noticed my under eye area is very soft and smooth! Will definitely repurchase!

I feel like it has really helped with brightening up my skin, but not with reducing puffiness like I was hoping. This might be due to me not drinking enough water, though. I really like the consistency of this cream, and it has helped make my skin more plump. I would recommend.

avis.titre: Carded a decade above the legal age!
avis.texte: After working long shifts at the hospital during COVID, this eye peptide saved my youth! I noticed a brightened look under my eyes and colleagues teased me for getting my beauty sleep not knowing this was my secret. I even got carded with my mask while I'm a decade above the legal age! This transformed my life. Additionally it helped to heal and hide a dog bit scar I had on my face! Just an added bonus! I would highly recommend and purchase!
Need to use this more long term, but liking it so far. COSRX products are amazing.
I just starting using Cosrx products and wanted to give this eye cream a try, and I was not disappoint. It's very moist but yet not heavy or oily! I am buying my 2nd bottle!!

avis.titre: good product, my skin is too sensitive
avis.texte: had small red bumps after using this, but it's a good product. my skin just hates everything lol. my skin reacted like this to the snail serum as well.

I've used snail peptide masks and eye patches for years and was glad to discover this cream! It's not at all drippy like some of the patches and masks. Consistency is liquid out of the bottle, then super thick when applied, but does not harden like some other products out there. Stays on all night and washes off easily in the morning. If you like to sleep with an eye mask, would recommend getting the kind that people use after a surgery and a larger size so the cream is untouched. However, it will stay on with a regular satin mask as well.

Consistency is good and no scent however after the third use I developed small red and itchy bumps underneath my eye. Another shot because I thought it may have been my dermatitis but now after use under eye feels very tight and sore.

I honestly can't say i've seen a difference in brightening as i don't really have dark under eyes, but this is amazing for me in terms of hydration and i feel like i've noticed a difference in the wrinkles around my eyes. it's lightweight but very moisturizing. Before i used this i noticed my makeup would look cakey around my eyes but i haven't had that problem since using this

This eye cream is a great lightweight cream that is definitely brightening up my undereyes and diminishing the fine lines around them. A little goes a long way so I feel like you get a lot for your money with this product. I would definitely use it again:

I have really enjoyed using this eye cream the past few weeks. It is a great creamy texture and leaves the skin around my eyes feeling super hydrated and firm. This eye cream does not sting or burn my eyes at all! I plan on purchasing again when I finish this bottle. :)

I have extremely dry skin and horrible bags. This eye cream has kept my under eyes moisturized for more than 24hrs. The skin feels so soft and definitely brightens. For diminishing my eyes bags, I honestly didn't notice it, but my siblings said my eye bags had gotten severely less, (and u know its true when ur sibs finally compliment u lol). If you're going to wear makeup, I recommend using the eye cream in an hour advance because it takes a while to dry.
Seems like a nice moisturizing eye cream. Was using RoC retinol eye cream which didn't seem to be anything special, this product feels better quality. Would buy again.
I LOVED this cream. I let my mom use it and she noticed a huge improvement in the circles around her eyes. You do have to apply it daily but you WILL see results after about 2 weeks!!
something refreshing for the eyes, I have already used it for several weeks and the difference is very noticeable
I don't usually use eye creams, but I got this as a sample and fell in love. Nice moisture around the eyes and helps with any minor bagging I experience in the mornings
This is such a gentle but very moisturizing eye cream. It does a great job at keeping my under eyes hydrated while increasing firmness.

I really like this eye cream for my dry under eyes.I feel like it really provides an extreme amount of hydration without feeling heavy.I love trying new K beauty skincare and I recommend this to anyone needing extra moisture in the delicate eye area.

I purchased this as I heard great things about cosrx and I started noticing dryness and lines in my under eye area. It has been several months since I started using it and I use it twice a day (morning and night) and I can say I have seen great improvement in my under eye area. A little goes a long way and I still haven't finished the bottle. very happy with this eye cream!

The COSRX Advanced Snail Peptide Eye Cream helps brighten and moisturize the under eyes. It is a lightweight formula that visibly plumps and hydrates. It has peptides and snail mucin that really work well for anti-aging. I have seen my dark circles under my eyes become brighter and lighter. My under eyes are definitely less puffy. I would recommend this.

This eye cream feels great on yhe skin. Can see a definable difference after using ut for three weeks. I love that it doesnt havr any type of scent to it. It is t sticky like others ive tried. My eyes look and feel great aftet using it.
I was intrigued by this product but didn't notice any real differences after use. I tried to wait as long as I could for something to happen but it wasn't noticeable
I was really excited to try this product! I was looking for a new eye cream but unfortunately it didn't do much for me. It was a little sticky when applied but it had a nice glow that I really liked.
So far I really enjoy this eye cream. It has a great consistency and moisturizes well!

I would say in the 30 days or so been using it I did not notice any difference with my skin other than it felt very slimy and took a long time to absorb into the skin. More so than other ones I abused. I wouldn't spend the extra money on this because it didn't show any results maybe it needs to be used for a longer period of time but the 30 days for me did not do anything
I've been loving this eye cream. My eyes have never been so hydrated and moisturized. Also my dark circles are slowly fading and puffiness is gone.
I haven't used an eye cream in awhile but this is gentle around the eyes, hydrating without being too heavy and affordable
Great product I loved the texture but is a little too rich for my eyes
I love this under my eyes! Super moisturizing and lasted a really long time.
Usually eye creams don't show me much improvement but this one is different. I can tell after continuous use, that my undereye is starting to depuff a bit and lighten a bit too.

I absolutely love this brand for one, and adore snail peptide products for use at home. This totally makes me feel like I took a trip to the spa. My skin is glowing and is making me so proud to go make up free!

I've had very dark under eyes from a young age, so it is what it is at that point. But what I will say is that it actually is quite hydrating. I've added it to my night/day routine after I wash my face. I would check it out not everything works for me. But this this is doing something

avis.titre: Will definitely but again and again!!
avis.texte: I've been looking into Korean skincare, and oh my gosh. This eye cream is FANTASTIC! Saw results in days. Love It.

I am a fan of the OG snail mucin essence and when I got to try the eye cream I was so excited. I love how hydrating it is. And it has my favourite ingredient Niacinamide that really brightens up my under eye. Also the peptides are an added bonus for anti-ageing. It's an all rounder

I heard so many great things about this brand and what the snail slime could do for your skin. I was very excited finding out they had an eye cream. Very hydrating and non irritating like my other expensive eye creams

First of all, I love the consistency of this eye cream. A little goes a very long way. Any leftovers I have after applying to my eyes I apply to other fine lines on my face. The cream absorbs well into skin and is super moisturizing. Great for day or night time use. I would recommend this eye cream.
i love this line of cosrx products but i hadn't ever tried an eye cream by them and i was blown away. i love the texture and its nice and plumping

This is an amazing product that REALLY works! COSRX Advanced Snail Peptide Eye Cream is lightweight with a silky texture, super moisturizing, and sinks in fast. I can wear it with heavy eye makeup and false lashes, no problem. If you can get past the snail peptide portion of it (wink, wink) - I promise you won't be disappointed. This eye cream is absolutely worth its weight in gold!
